gloss_en: the birds of the kelipah — impure spiritual forces ('birds' dwelling in the husk of impurity) that suckle from the breasts of Malkhut and constitute the mental faculties (mochin) of the Malkhut of the kelipah; the source from which a wicked musician draws his melody (Likutey Moharan I:3, after the Zohar and the Arizal)
